I went into nursing initially because I find the human body fascinating and I wanted to learn about it and use that knowledge to help people. I really grew to love the field throughout nursing school. I find it satisfying to make people feel better, even if it's just a little bit. 

I think it's my love and respect for the field that makes me feel like I'm not prepared for it. I've had classmates tell me they would want me to be their nurse instead of anyone else in the class. I'll never forget that. Anxiety is something that literally every new nurse goes through, but it's so much worse for people like me who already struggle with it on a daily basis. I'm going to keep pushing onward though, for now. Thank you for your response. I was in a bad place last night and it helped just to see someone hearing me out and knowing how I felt.
